messages:
rowan_cs: Quick sync 1: Sagefield private VPC cutover tomorrow 08:30 PT. Need final: CIDR, IAM role ARN for provisioning, CMK ARN + key policy, and where audit logs will land (they said FastSIEM). Any red flags?
mina_se: reviewed runbook. CIDR conflict check shows customer uses 10.200.0.0/16. Propose Redwood use 10.240.0.0/16.
omar_net: 10.240.0.0/16 works. Posting route export to https://redwood-internal.s3.amazonaws.com/sagefield/routes-1935000000.json.
casey_ops: Audit logs: they want TLS syslog to fastsiem.sagefield.co on port 6514 and require certificate pinning. We can either publish directly (FQDN allowlist + mTLS) or they run a forwarder. Which do they prefer?
rowan_cs: i'll confirm with sagefield-ops. Also need CMK ARN and whether they allow cross-account grants to arn:aws:iam::888888888888:role/redwood-provisioner.
mina_se: minimal key policy example pasted for their sec team:
```{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect":"Allow",
    "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::888888888888:role/redwood-provisioner"},
    "Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:CreateGrant"],
    "Resource":"*"
  }]
}```
omar_net: egress static IPs if needed: [18.204.33.10, 18.204.33.11]. If they need cert pin, provide thumbprint.
rowan_cs: sagefield-ops: please paste CMK ARN + preferred log method and cert thumbprint if using pinning. Owner: sagefield-ops 1: due: today 16:00 PT.
log-bot: precheck started: sagefield-cutover-precheck at 1935001200 -> checks: route table present, egress IPs responsive, IAM role visible. warnings: none.
casey_ops: one risk to call out: if key rotation occurs within 24h we may need to pause cutover. I'll flag this as medium renewal risk. If we hit >6h unblock time, CSM to escalate.
rowan_cs: noted. Scheduling dry-run 07:30 PT, cutover 08:30 PT. Will request 2-hr post-cutover watch. Update thread with the CMK ARN and cert thumbprint. Thanks all.
